scripts.title: Set Folder Icon Win
scripts.description: Easily customize and personalize your Windows directories with a sleek, drag-and-drop interface. Set Folder Icon is a lightweight, efficient utility built with PowerShell that streamlines the traditionally tedious process of updating folder appearances. Instead of digging through nested properties menus, you can simply drag your target folder and .ico file directly into the application, click Set, and let the script handle the rest—automatically configuring desktop.ini attributes, applying system flags, and refreshing the Windows icon cache for instant, hassle-free results.

guide.title: Save the script
guide.description: Save the source code with a .ps1 extension (e.g., SetFolderIcon.ps1).

guide.title: Run the script
guide.description: Right-click the file and select Run with PowerShell (or execute it directly via the PowerShell CLI).

scripts.useCase:
Visual Organization & Quick Identification: Instantly distinguish high-priority, active, or frequently accessed directories from standard folders using unique, thematic icons, reducing search time in cluttered drives.

Media & Entertainment Libraries: Organize personal collections—such as movies, music albums, e-books, and video projects—with custom imagery (like dedicated media or streaming logos) to create a clean, media-hub aesthetic.

Development & Client Work Management: Assign specific framework, brand, or project logos (e.g., Android, design tools, code repositories) to distinct work environments so you can navigate complex project directories at a glance.

Workspace Decluttering & Aesthetics: Transform a monotonous grid of standard yellow Windows folders into a personalized, visually engaging dashboard that matches your custom desktop theme.

Streamlined Customization for Power Users: Bypass the multi-step native Windows method (Properties > Customize > Change Icon) with a fast, centralized tool that automates attribute management and instantly forces the Windows icon cache to update.
